# Part 1: Kaplan-Meier curve calculation

The data listed below are from a study on the toxic effect of Respisonide. Twelve mice received a large dose of Respisonide and the time until death was recorded. 

The survival times (in hours) of the mice were

```
  50  50*  51  66*  82  92  120*  140 150 180 190
```

A '\*' indicates that an observation was censored (i.e. '50*' means that the actual survival time of the mouse is not observed, but the mouse was still alive 50 hours after receiving the drug). 

## Q1.1: Calculate the Kaplan-Meier curve by hand

Complete the following table. When both an event and censoring happens at a point in time (50), assume that leaving the risk set happens after you calculate the hazard.

**fillin**:

| Time  | # Risk Set | # Events | Hazard     | Cumulative Survival |
|------:|-----------:|---------:|-----------:|--------------------:|
|     0 |            |          |            |                     |
|    50 |            |          |            |                     |
|    51 |            |          |            |                     |
|    66 |            |          |            |                     |
|    82 |            |          |            |                     |
|    92 |            |          |            |                     |
|   120 |            |          |            |                     |
|   140 |            |          |            |                     |
|   150 |            |          |            |                     |
|   180 |            |          |            |                     |
|   190 |            |          |            |                     |



Check your computations with R. Use the following code.

```{r}
  library('lumc.dabs')
  library('survival')
  data(mice)
  data <- mice
  data$Event <- data$Death == 'death'
  km <- survfit(Surv(Time, Event) ~ 1, data)
  summary(km)
```

The term `Surv(Time, Event)` defines a survival time object in R that combines a column measuring time with a second column indicating censoring/event (so called event indicator). The indicator should be 0 for censoring and 1 when an event happened (check this with `as.integer(data$Event)`).

## Q1.2: What is the median survival?

Plot the Kaplan-Meier curve.

```{r}
  plot(km)
```

Read off median suvival.
